name: scribb.it
description: The write product of Blockspace Holdings: scribb.it inscribes content onto Bitcoin, and this repository holds the shared platform every Blockspace product builds on.

roles.name: inscription-engine
roles.purpose: Turns content into a committed and revealed inscription: quoted exactly before a satoshi moves, and recoverable when a reveal is left behind.
roles.measure: Reveals whose fee prediction matched the signed transaction to the vbyte

roles.name: fee-oracle
roles.purpose: Aggregates fee estimates from the mempool and the network and publishes the one rate the engine quotes against.
roles.measure: Quoted rate confirmed within one block of the target

roles.name: agent-gateway
roles.purpose: Serves the platform to agents: authenticates who is asking, limits what one caller may consume, and answers in the contract's shape.
roles.measure: Requests answered within the published contract, and none answered outside it

roles.name: settlement
roles.purpose: Posts what was paid and what was owed when an inscription or an invoice completes, issues the signed receipt, and refunds what did not complete.
roles.measure: Settled invoices whose receipt verifies offline under our published key

x-bitcoin.comment: Scribbit extension carried by @bsh/mesh; not part of aao 0.1.
x-bitcoin.custody: non-custodial: the platform never holds a user's private key (ADR-0002)
